description: Java source code for the Snake activity in an Android game application. Defines the main activity class, handles lifecycle events, input events, and references the SnakeView for game logic and rendering.

classes.name: Snake
classes.description: Main activity class for the Snake game, manages game lifecycle, user input, and ties together game view and state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, and configures the game view and touch listener.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the game when the activity is paused.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current game state into a bundle for state restoration.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles hardware key events to change the snake's direction.
